verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no Airbyte sandbox or test environment that isolates testing from production data. Running a local instance with abctl or the OSS quickstart, using multiple workspaces, or loading data into PyAirbyte caches are deployment options or user-side arrangements, not a sandbox capability. The API 'Try It!' console runs against the live api.airbyte.com with a real token, which is not isolated testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
